archive.source_task_ids_note: Both reviews are claimed here. The archive nevertheless stays `queued` rather than `completed`: see state_note.

completion_gate: Every claim promoted into EV-AES-005 is one the validator CONFIRMED; a claim the validator marked OVERSTATED or DOES NOT FOLLOW appears with that verdict, not with a strength.
If the random-permutation control killed the mod-8 residue, EV-AES-005 records the withdrawal as the batch's result rather than omitting the claim.
The decision fills knowledge_promotion or states why promotion is not warranted.
The goal record carries exactly one next_action and is NOT set to completed.
constraints: Assign no claim tier above what the validator confirmed and the red team did not overturn.
Scope every conclusion to the tested round counts, key size, solver and budget; assert nothing about full-round or deployed AES.
Cite the experiment, task and receipt IDs supporting every conclusion.
Do NOT mark the goal completed: closure needs a three-model quorum this harness cannot resolve. Record that as the blocking reason if a criterion is otherwise met.
deliverables: EV-AES-005 with per-claim strength and explicit claim boundaries.
DEC-20260802-007 with the coordinator ruling, the knowledge_promotion field filled or refused with a reason, and exactly one next_action.
GOAL-AES-003 updated with the BATCH-001 checkpoint and latest_verified_commit.
ledger-receipt.json with commit sha, parent sha, per-path sha256 and record IDs.
handoff.objective: Mint EV-AES-005 and DEC-20260802-007 from the reviewed package, set the GOAL-AES-003 BATCH-001 checkpoint, and verify the commit.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: What this batch officially established, at which claim tier, and what the single next action is.

dispatches.title: Archive the reviewed GOAL-AES-003 BATCH-001 ledger transition

objective: Close the GOAL-AES-003 BATCH-001 lifecycle over the reduced-round AES attack and distinguisher work that was ALREADY BUILT AND RUN in this batch's task directories. THE IRREGULARITY IS RECORDED RATHER THAN HIDDEN: the producer artifacts were written and committed in ad-hoc commits before this queue existed, so the four producer tasks below are entered at state `completed` and their receipts bind the raw artifacts by hash after the fact. What was genuinely missing, and what this queue supplies, is the part that makes the work official: an independent review by a session that did not produce it, a red-team pass on the cost model and the claim tiers, and a ledger archive minting EV-AES-005 and DEC-20260802-007. The single highest-value check in the batch is the matched random-permutation control on the mod-8 counting statistic: if a random permutation also reads 0 mod 8, the residue is an artifact of the counting rather than a distinguisher, and the batch's strongest claim collapses. That outcome is a legitimate and reportable result of this batch.
